page.overview:
What is Mini Bot 5000?

The Mini Bot 5000 is a minor character in Frailty, the first story of Tales from the Pizzaplex 1: Lally's Game. It was a robot made as part of a group project for Jessica and Robert.

The Mini Bot 5000 is a small robot that was melded together with various metal part from the junkyard and the rest having been bought from the hardware store, its flat tray lying on his back. It's arm was fused with aluminum tubing, with its wires tucked inside. When they were testing it, it was not yet painted.

When they start presenting it, they painted some of its part of Robert's favorite color; blue.

The Mini Bot 5000 was made as part of a group project by Mrs. Willoughby, with Jessica and Robert being paired up together. They first went to Robert's house, with Robert working on soldering the wires into the miniature bot. After finishing, Jessica comes up with the name Mini Bot 5000, with it gaining a chuckle out of Robert
